tagline: Leader in acute care solutions and surgical workflows
hero_kpi_rationale: The Acute Care Therapies segment is the primary driver of growth and profitability for Getinge, representing the largest share of sales and benefiting from structural demand driven by aging populations and increased surgical procedures.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Getinge achieved net sales of 34.969 billion SEK in 2025 (fiscal year ended December 2025), with organic growth of 4.9%, supported by its key acute care and life science segments.
kpis.signal: Organic growth of 4.9% in 2025, supported by all three segments.

kpis.name: Adjusted Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Adjusted gross margin stood at 50.4% in 2025, down from 52.1% in Q1 2025 due to negative currency effects, tariff costs, and volume declines in certain segments.
kpis.signal: Gross margin under pressure due to unfavorable currency effects and tariff costs.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITA Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit (EBITA) divided by net sales.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA margin stood at 14.0% in 2025 (vs 12.1% in Q1 2025), reflecting the impact of negative currency effects and tariff costs, partially offset by price adjustments and cost control.
kpis.signal: EBITA margin under pressure despite continued efforts on pricing and productivity.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Sales
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses reported as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Getinge maintains a stable R&D investment level around 4.8%, focused on advanced medical devices. The 2025 period marked an important regulatory milestone with CE marking approval for the new Cardiohelp II and EU MDR approval for Intergard Synergy.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in medical innovation and strategic regulatory achievements.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to support growth and modernization.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures remain elevated to modernize production sites, strengthen supply chain resilience, and support new product development.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to strengthen supply chain resilience.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Getinge has approximately 12,000 employees globally. The group continues organizational rationalization efforts noted in restructuring costs related to organizational structure optimization.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount with ongoing organizational rationalization.

kpis.name: Acute Care Therapies Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by products for intensive care, operating rooms, and circulatory support therapies.
kpis.description: The Acute Care Therapies segment generated 18.675 billion SEK in 2025. Organic growth declined 4.0% in Q1 2026, primarily due to temporarily elevated ventilator volumes in 2025 linked to market consolidation. ECLS (extracorporeal circulation) therapy consumables continue to show stable growth from a global market-leading position.
kpis.signal: Organic decline of 4.0% in Q1 2026 due to ventilator decline following 2025 market consolidation, partially offset by stable ECLS consumables growth.

kpis.name: Life Science Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from equipment and solutions for laboratories, pharmaceutical production, and biopharmaceutical processing.
kpis.description: The Life Science segment recorded 4.498 billion SEK in 2025. Organic growth reached 16% in Q1 2026, driven by all product segments, notably Sterile Transfer which contributed most. Order backlog increased due to Bio-Processing recovery, while WIS faces geopolitical uncertainty and a challenging investment climate in the pharmaceutical sector.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth of 16% in Q1 2026 despite difficult pharmaceutical investment climate, driven by Sterile Transfer and Bio-Processing.

kpis.name: Surgical Workflows Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from equipment and services for operating rooms, infection prevention, and cleaning solutions.
kpis.description: The Surgical Workflows segment achieved 11.796 billion SEK in 2025. Organic growth reached 4.0% in Q1 2026, driven by consumables and services growth in Infection Control, operating tables, and order backlog increasing 13.3% organically due to all product segments, notably operating room equipment in the United States.
kpis.signal: Organic growth of 4.0% in Q1 2026 driven by Infection Control consumables and services and operating tables.

risks.title: Dependence on critical component suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk positioned at the start of the section (page 40). Intensive language ('vital part', 'disrupted operations'). Trend stable but aggravated in 2025 by geopolitical turbulence. Significant weight in medical supply chain.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and medical device quality
risks.score_rationale: Critical operational risk (page 41), mentioned first among operational risks. Very intensive language ('extensive assessments', 'top priority'). Trend stable but requiring continuous investment. Very high categorical weight for medical industry.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of connected equipment and customer data
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk (page 41), dedicated to digital product security. Intensive language ('extortion or sabotage cannot be excluded'). Trend stable but rising with increasing digitalization. High weight for connected medical sector.

risks.title: Increased competition and rapid technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: Major external risk (page 40) and strategic risk (page 43). Moderate language but repeated ('fast pace', 'transformative technology'). Trend stable but increasing pressure. High weight for maintaining market leadership.

risks.title: Product liability and quality risks
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk (page 41). Intensive language ('large amounts', 'significant legal expenses'). Trend stable but inherent to medical sector. High weight for potential financial impact.

risks.title: Non-compliance with ethical, anti-corruption, and trade sanctions laws
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk (page 41). Intensive language ('zero tolerance policy', 'extensive action'). Trend stable but aggravated by geopolitical context. High weight for reputation and global operations.

risks.title: Dependence on digitalization innovation and product development
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk (page 43). Intensive language ('crucial for maintaining', 'long term market position'). Trend stable but critical for future growth. High weight for growth strategy.

risks.title: Intellectual property and patent litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk (page 43). Moderate language ('cannot be ruled out', 'material costs'). Trend stable. Moderate weight for highly innovative sector.
